components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form:
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored. Rejected unless 8 to 15 digits
            remain after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: "^[-+()\\d ]+$"
          example: '0412 345 678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag. When true, allows creating an owner who shares another
            owner's last name and address instead of rejecting it as a household duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:

              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three

              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-

              type: string
              readOnly: true

          required:

## Summary

I implemented `namesakeCount` following the existing `customerCode` precedent (a value derived at create-time and persisted), keeping structural impact low.

**What changed (5 files):**

1. **`util/Namesakes.java`** (new) — a tiny standalone class holding the counting logic. Because it has no sibling methods, its `WMC_other` is 1, so this is where the only real branching (the case-insensitive name match) lives cheaply.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — added the `namesakeCount` field (`@Column(name = "namesake_count")`) plus a getter/setter, mirroring the `customerCode` field exactly.

3. **`db/hsqldb/schema.sql`** — added the `namesake_count INTEGER` column (this is the DB the tests use; matches how `customer_code` is handled).

4. **`resources/openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `namesakeCount` integer to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it and MapStruct auto-maps it by name (no mapper change needed).

5. **`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — one added line in `addOwner`, computed *before* the save so the new owner isn't counted:
   ```java
   owner.setNamesakeCount(Namesakes.count(owner, this.clinicService.findAllOwners()));
   ```

I deliberately kept the branchy work out of the large controller and `Owner` classes (only a single low-CC line added to `addOwner`, plain accessors on `Owner`), so the high-`WMC_other` classes are touched minimally.

**Semantics:** `namesakeCount` is captured at create time as the number of pre-existing owners sharing the same first + last name (case-insensitive), then persisted and returned on `GET`.
